What are digital products? A digital product is something you create once and sell online without having to be there in person. It’s usually information, instructions, or a skill written down or recorded so other people can use it. Digital products are things like PDFs, guides, checklists, templates, video walkthroughs, or short courses. They exist to help someone solve a specific problem. If you’ve ever figured out how to budget your money, organize your life, fix your credit, create a routine, or do something faster and more efficiently, that knowledge can be turned into a digital product. You don’t need a degree. You don’t need a big following. You don’t need to be an expert. You just need to know how to explain something clearly that other people are still struggling with.
